name: MERF Scene Representation
definition: Represents a scene using a low-resolution 3D voxel grid and three high-resolution 2D grids (one for each cardinal plane) to store feature vectors. The continuous field is the sum of trilinearly interpolated 3D values and bilinearly interpolated 2D values.
summary: MERF is a memory-efficient radiance field using a sparse 3D voxel grid and three high-resolution 2D feature planes to enable real-time rendering of large-scale unbounded scenes with low memory usage.
